li.label: they stayed
li.description: They could have left with their own people, but they stayed here. I think I'm part of the reason.

li.label: silver for a stranger
li.description: We paid good silver for one more mouth at the table. I hope the new one can at least cook.

li.label: watched them leave
li.description: I stood out past the fields and watched them go until I couldn't see them anymore.

li.label: not wanted there
li.description: I asked those people for a place among them, and they turned me down. Their walls are ugly anyway.

li.label: an apology, of sorts
li.description: The guest apologized to me through gritted teeth. It was a terrible apology, but I'll take it.

li.label: made me grovel
li.description: I was made to apologize in front of a room full of mud farmers. I won't forget whose face I was looking at.

li.label: insulted under my own roof
li.description: A guest said that to my face at my own table, and we went on passing the salt. I keep thinking of better answers.

li.label: we let guests walk on us
li.description: A visitor insulted one of ours at dinner, and we all just kept eating.

li.label: the council threw them out for me
li.description: A guest insulted me, and the council sent their whole party off our land for it.

li.label: guests driven off
li.description: One guest had a big mouth, so the council sent the whole party away. The others had done nothing wrong.

li.label: sold what they left me
li.description: It was the last thing I had of them, and I sold it to a trader. The silver spends just fine, and that's the worst part.

li.label: kept the heirloom
li.description: A trader wanted my heirloom, but I kept it. It isn't for sale.

li.label: wouldn't sell
li.description: They wouldn't sell, not even at my price. I respect that.

li.label: silver walked away
li.description: A trader offered good silver, and we turned it down over sentiment. The stores could have used it.

li.label: silver in the stores
li.description: One of us finally sold an old keepsake to a trader. You can't eat a keepsake.

li.label: my prisoner went home
li.description: I asked the council to free a prisoner, and they did. They're on their way home now because I spoke up.

li.label: soft on prisoners
li.description: We caught a raider, fed them, and then let them walk out the gate. They'll be back with friends.

li.label: talked through the cell door
li.description: We talked through the cell door for three evenings. I know about their mother's goat and the scar on their knee now.

li.label: my plea for a prisoner refused
li.description: I asked the council to let a prisoner go home, and they said no. I still carry the meals down.

li.label: bandaging raiders now
li.description: They came to kill us, and now we're spending good medicine on one of them.

li.label: one less raider
li.description: We gave a dying raider a quick end. One less of them.

li.label: we killed someone lying down
li.description: They were on the ground, they were begging, and we killed them anyway. I keep hearing the begging.

li.label: finished a fallen enemy
li.description: I finished off a wounded enemy. They looked at me the whole time.

li.label: left them to bleed
li.description: A wounded raider was calling for help all afternoon, and we left them to it.

li.label: we fed the hungry
li.description: Hungry people came to the gate, and we fed them. I watched them eat.

li.label: gave our stores away
li.description: We worked all season for that food, and the council gave it away to strangers.

li.label: turned the hungry away
li.description: We turned hungry people away from the gate. One of them was carrying a child who'd stopped crying.

li.label: paid for my animal's bite
li.description: We paid a stranger silver because they put their fingers near my animal's mouth. It wasn't my animal's fault.

li.label: the council stood by my animal
li.description: A guest got bitten, and the council took my animal's side. It's had extra treats since.

li.label: bitten, then blamed
li.description: Their animal took a piece out of my hand, and I got the blame for it.

li.label: my animal given away
li.description: They gave my animal to a stranger to settle a bite. It got loose on the way out, and now it's out there somewhere.

li.label: the hunt is on
li.description: There's a big predator denning nearby, and we're going after it. Finally, a reason to get up early.

li.label: hunting a fine animal
li.description: It's the finest animal I've seen in a year, and we're sending hunters after it. All that muscle, for the butcher's table.

li.label: a predator worth taming
li.description: That predator would make the best guard animal we've ever had, if it doesn't eat me first.

li.label: making friends with a predator
li.description: One of us is trying to tame a predator, and the council approved it. I've moved my bed away from the door.

li.label: something watching from the brush
li.description: There's a predator denning in sight of the colony, and the council decided to leave it be. I count heads at dinner now.

li.label: it's mine now
li.description: They said I can keep it! It almost knows its name already.

li.label: a wild thing indoors
li.description: We let a wild animal into the house because a child asked nicely. I know who'll end up cleaning up after it.

li.label: helping the handlers
li.description: I get to help tame it! I hold the food, and they said that's the most important job.

li.label: not allowed to keep it
li.description: It liked me, and they still said I can't keep it. I wasn't even going to let it sleep in my bed.

li.label: sneered at by a noble
li.description: A titled guest called my best work a pigsty, and I had to keep quiet. I built the table they were eating off.

li.label: knows their place
li.description: Their builder accepted my correction without a fuss. That's rare among frontier folk.

li.label: told a noble what's what
li.description: I told that noble exactly what their title is worth out here. My hands are still shaking.

li.label: an insolent builder
li.description: A common builder lectured me at dinner. I have written it down, so that I may remember it precisely.

li.label: that tonic actually worked
li.description: The trader's tonic tasted like a swamp in a boot, but I slept like a log. I want the recipe.

li.label: paid silver for pond water
li.description: That tonic was just colored water in a pretty bottle, and we paid silver for it.

li.label: silver down someone's throat
li.description: We spent good silver on a trader's tonic. I'd bet it was pond water.

li.label: what if it worked
li.description: The tonic was probably just water. I keep thinking about that little green bottle anyway.

li.label: my past, bought back
li.description: The council paid a stranger to keep quiet about my past, and never asked what it was. I owe them for that.

li.label: silver for someone's secret
li.description: Good silver went to a visitor to keep one of us from being exposed. They won't say who.

li.label: they let my past walk in
li.description: A visitor from my old life told the whole table about my past. The council could have paid them to keep quiet, and didn't.

li.label: they scared my past away
li.description: A visitor tried to sell what they knew about me, and our people ran them off. I didn't think they'd do that for me.

li.label: threatened over an old debt
li.description: I offered a fair trade and got cornered behind the storeroom for it. I still know what I know about them.

li.label: we lean on visitors now
li.description: A few of ours took a guest behind the storeroom and threatened them. I didn't think we were that kind of colony.

li.label: going after the beast
li.description: The animal that mauled one of ours is back, and this time we're hunting it.

li.label: they're hunting the beast
li.description: They're going out after the animal that mauled one of us. I'm afraid it'll get another one.

li.label: cooped up indoors
li.description: We've been stuck indoors for days because of one animal. I've counted the knots in the ceiling twice.

li.label: taming the thing that mauled us
li.description: That animal mauled one of us, and now we're trying to tame it. I'll be sleeping with my door barred.

li.label: my nemesis will answer for it
li.description: The order's been given. Soon the one who hurt me will be gone.

li.label: an execution on the schedule
li.description: We're going to execute a prisoner in chains. I know what they did, but I don't want to watch.

li.label: my nemesis under our roof
li.description: The one who hurt me eats our bread a few doors from my bed. I can hear them coughing at night.

li.label: they want my nemesis as one of us
li.description: The council wants to recruit the one who nearly killed me. They could end up sleeping down the hall from me.

li.label: recruiting my friend's attacker
li.description: They're trying to recruit the one who hurt my friend. I'll have to share a table with them.

li.label: my animal was sold
li.description: My animal was sold to a stranger. It slipped its rope past the fields, and now it's out there on its own.

li.label: sold my animal, at a good price
li.description: I miss my animal, but we got a lot of silver for it. I miss it a little less every time I count it.

li.label: my animal isn't for sale
li.description: A stranger offered good silver for my animal, and the council said no. It's asleep on my feet right now.

li.label: a healer saw to my old injury
li.description: A traveling healer worked on my old injury with warm hands and hot stones. It aches less now.

li.label: mud rubbed in for silver
li.description: We paid good silver for a healer to rub mud into my old injury. It hurts just the same, and the mud is still there.

li.label: lessons from a traveling healer
li.description: I spent the afternoon with a traveling healer. Half of what they said was nonsense, but I'm keeping the other half.

li.label: the healer's practice dummy
li.description: The healer used me to teach the others, poking and prodding all afternoon. My old injury is no better.

li.label: it still aches
li.description: There was a healer right here, and the council decided my old injury wasn't worth the silver. It still aches.
